messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGER: High error rate detected for customer HaloEdge on Dedicated cluster ded-usw2-22. Metric: inference_gateway.5xx_rate spiked from 0.2% -> 9.4% over last 3m. Rolling deploys: none. Impact: increased latency and failures for ~120 tenants but concentrated on HaloEdge. Pager assigned to Jess (oncall). Link: https://infra.redwood/alerts/ALERT-7722 :rotating_light:
Jess (oncall): on it. grabbing dashboards and runbooks. can someone post the runbook link? any recent capacity ops on ded-usw2-22?
Omar (SRE): runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-5xx-eviction. quick triage: GPU util on node pool p-22 is at 96% on NCH nodes, KV cache evictions rising, inference gateway 502/503s correlated with worker restarts. suspect noisy tenant or model overload. pulling top-ten tenants by qps now.
Nina (eng-runtime): I see a steady stream of long-sequence requests pinned to a single model variant 'gptx-13b-fp16' from HaloEdge. Their tail-latency distribution is huge (p95 2.4s -> p99 8.3s). That creates backpressure to the gateway and inflight queue.
Kevin (platform): no scheduled scaling this morning. autoscaler on this pool is at max for the tier due to reserved commitments. We can either migrate HaloEdge to a spare pool (manual) or throttle at the gateway per-tenant. Migration will take ~6-8m to drain sessions safely. Throttle can be immediate.
Lia (solutions): lia -> HaloEdge contact: they've reported failed requests and timeout errors in their dashboard since ~08:42 UTC. their SLAs show 99.9 latency and 99.95 availability; current slice is below target. Preparing customer update once we have mitigation.
support-bot: suggested customer-facing blurb: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting inference requests. We're applying mitigations and will update in 15 mins. No data exposure." Use if ready.
Jess (oncall): proposed mitigation plan: 1) apply per-tenant QPS cap 2) enable fallback to gptx-6b for non-critical routes 3) if that doesn't reduce 5xx, migrate tenant to spare pool. I'll start with step 1 and 2. @Kevin can you prepare route for migration if needed?
Omar (SRE): command to set per-tenant cap (internal):
```
infractl tenant-rate-limit set --tenant haloedge --qps 8 --duration 30m
```
Applying now. watching metrics.
Nina (eng-runtime): also enabling model-fallback rule in router: fallback to gptx-6b for requests with prompt_size > 1024 or streaming disabled. config snippet:
```
router.rules.add({ tenant: 'haloedge', criteria: { model: 'gptx-13b-fp16', prompt_len_gt: 1024 }, action: { fallback: 'gptx-6b', max_tokens: 1024 } })
```
Applying shortly.
Omar (SRE): rate-limiter applied. immediate drop in gateway 5xx from 9.4% -> 4.1% in 60s. KV evictions still high but CPU/gpu pressure dropping slightly. p95 latency down ~350ms.
Jess (oncall): lia, can you draft the short update for HaloEdge? include ETA for next update in 15m.
Lia (solutions): crafting now. Suggested: "We applied temporary QPS limits and a fallback model to reduce failed requests. You may see lower throughput or responses from a smaller model for long prompts. We're monitoring and will update in 15 minutes."
Kevin (platform): pre-warming spare pool p-24 for possible migration. estimate warm + drain ~7 minutes. Preparing migration plan: cordon 1 node, drain non-critical sessions, then shift tenant pins. If we go that route notify ops to expect short routing wobble.
Omar (SRE): additional telemetry: top offending session IDs show repeated full-length streaming requests (no chunked streaming) holding KV cache keys. Might be client-side anti-pattern. I'll open a short request-log snippet to share with HaloEdge if OK (no PII).
Jess (oncall): good. keep monitoring. if 5xx <1% within 20m, keep mitigations and follow up with post-incident notes. if >5% or customer reports elevated errors, escalate to full migration.
incident-bot: METRIC UPDATE: 5xx_rate at 00:12 since mitigation = 0.9% (downside). Inflight queue depth reduced by 45%.
Lia (solutions): sent customer update (private): "We've implemented a temporary throttling and fallback to reduce errors; performance improving. Next update in 15 minutes or sooner if resolved."
Jess (oncall): marking current state == mitigated -> monitoring. creating follow-up ticket to analyze root cause and improve tenant-level protection (rate-limit automation + auto-migration heuristics). ticket: https://triage.redwood/tickets/INC-7722-followup
Omar (SRE): will collect heap/gpu dumps from node pool p-22 and annotate noisy tenant footprint for runtime team. Nina, please confirm whether we should autosuggest per-tenant limits in console for heavy models.
Nina (eng-runtime): yes — follow-up action item to auto-suggest conservative QPS for large-model sequences. I'll add to backlog and propose default heuristics.
Jess (oncall): thanks team. I'll keep this thread open until we have postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
